messages: A short tour explains the main features.
The HR introduction explains the additional features available to this account.
The arrows select another month. Selecting the month name returns to the current month.
The overview shows recorded hours, the current month’s balance and the total balance including carryovers.
The daily working time is the target used for calculations. The federal state determines which German public holidays are shown. Changes are applied with Save.
Start, break and end form the daily entry. Changes are saved when a field is left or Enter is pressed.
Duration shows recorded working time; difference compares it with the daily target. Status and warnings identify weekends, public holidays or unusual entries.
Comments add context to a day. An absence can be marked with "Urlaub" or "Stundenausgleich". Depending on the period, HR approval is required; missing approval triggers a warning.
The switch changes how breaks are displayed: minutes or hours and minutes. The choice is saved for this account.
Export offers a file for the selected month or its calendar year. Both files use Excel format.
The Timesheet tab shows personal entries. The HR overview shows assigned employees, their balances and warnings.
This list contains the employees assigned to this HR account. It shows daily targets, balances, latest entries and warnings.
These figures summarize working hours and balances for the employees visible in this HR account.
These settings enable the existing weekly HR warning emails and set their thresholds. Group-based missing-day reminders are configured separately by an administrator.
These thresholds control the warnings shown in the employee overview. They are separate from the email notification settings.
Selecting an employee opens that person’s entries, settings and export. Back returns to the HR overview.
No employees are currently assigned. Individual timesheets become available when employees are assigned.
The profile menu provides access to personal details, account settings, appearance and accessibility options.
Help and privacy opens general Nextcloud guidance and privacy information. The compass icon can restart the Timesheet tour at any time.
